unresolved_on_purpose: The Handshake was seeded by Vela, who walked the parcel to Temir. That stays frontier_lore_handshake_protocol.hidden_truth. Senior couriers treat her appearance as a folk-tale. This slice does not stand her and does not teach the algebra.

The third relay was attacked by a Concordian operative under Warden Commander Voss. Ria has the proof. Temir suspects and cannot prove it. That stays frontier_lore_compromised_relays.hidden_truth. The public lines are three sabotaged relays, two silent, one partial log destroyed by its keeper, and a Guild that has not commented.

The parcel echo, the second request of the same hash from an off-schedule portal, the addressee written only as V., and Dorvik's question about who else can open a Handshake door stay frontier_lore_the_parcel_resurfaces. known_by is frontier_militia. Those sentences are not dialogue on the post hash.
Temir cultivating Ria as a defector stays his secret. The afternoon block that names ria_cultivation is unstaged. The field visits have location varies.
Vexa was Ria's apprentice. Twelve years of silence stay her secret. The public backstory is a Guild apprentice who walked away, a crew of walkaways, and the largest band.

Brunn has known for fifteen months, the deliveries have run two annums, and he is waiting for the boy to tell him. Those stay his secret. The public tension is that the grandson has begun delivering to the nearest Guild post, that Brunn knows, and that Brunn has not spoken of it.

The test sermon was prepared after a colleague said the Web is just code, three weeks ago, and has not been given. The week-count and the colleague stay his secret. The public tension is that senior Freenodes told him the Web is just code and that he is preparing a sermon in which that news is the test.

Zara has noticed lattice-Crucible scouts on her perimeter. That stays her secret. The public history is the Third Incursion, Year -3, broken on her perimeter, and eight hours of sleep she has not had since.
Hane Okra's master, Oren Voss's trade, Jensa Bell's infirmary, and Pell Orange's western watch have schedule rooms with no country coordinate. None of them are stood. No rifle is repaired on a pin.
Dust Rose is a child who arrived at ten during the incursion and refused to say from where. A child is not a presence. frontier_camp_edges has no coordinate.
Mara Pin's council room has no coordinate. q_frontier_hand_to_mira already carries her sealed letter. This slice does not open it and does not stand her.
Silas Quinn's western route is passable and undeclared. frontier_western_road has no coordinate. The route is not drawn. He is not stood. q_frontier_find_kel keeps the portal's sound.

Walker Lin greets by the first observed name and repeats a receipt code. guild_assigned_routes is not a district. is_conscious is false. The chassis is not a CX. The constitution has no line for continuity of an autonomous walker, and Ria refuses to discuss whether Lin remembers.

Dorvik's interactable hours sit on anchor_safehouse_intermediate, which is not a district id. courier_safehouses at night is interactable false. He is not stood. His twenty years, two ambushes, one lost leg, and the sentence that he had never lost a parcel stay his sheet. The lost-parcel lore is the public crack in that sentence, read from Ria's ledger, with Dorvik absent.
Kestra is a name in the lost-parcel sentence and has no npc sheet in this Canon folder. She is not invented as a CX.

cultures.name: The post
cultures.where: link_post_alpha hash, courier_safehouses hash empty beside it
cultures.public_fact: The Couriers carry what cannot be sent. Their goal is that no peer stays unreachable more than seven days, and that the chain of physical custody still settles what the cities count. Ria has run Link Post Alpha for thirty-two years. She names couriers and reserves the word walker for the autonomous kind. Year 8 is Helva's walk, eleven days, a sealed Refusal Compact, a camp where an ankle broke, and the first post. Year 100 made this ground the venue for inter-city Refusal disputes. The Guild and the Freenodes are rivals. The Guild and the Pioneers are allies. Reputation on the sheet is 70.
cultures.identity: A post identity is a name on a route and a hand that can be asked. The hash at (48.72, −9.79) is inside the Couriers disc only, 22.54 m from Pinewood. The placed post 16.19 m south-west is the S13 floor with cap 0. The safehouse hash 3.19 m away stays empty.
cultures.stops_before: Voss, the proof, Vela, the parcel echo, and any line added to the Guild constitution.

cultures.name: The peers
cultures.public_fact: Year 88, after eighty years of Guild monopoly, a predecessor of Temir's raised one solar relay that could handshake with no courier in the room. Seven more appeared inside a year. The Guild voted to shun them. The Freenodes voted to refuse the shunning. Both votes are in the Sovereign Archive. Year 91, Temir's Handshake: a parcel's record is valid only when both signatures are on it. The protocol has a public claim that no parcel was lost after it, and a later public sentence that the claim broke. Temir has brokered five cities and dissolved three. They refuse a conversation that picks a side before mid-month. The motto is that every peer is a sovereign. Reputation on the sheet is 55.
cultures.identity: A peer identity is a relay that can answer without a walker, and a signature that is useless alone. Temir's hash at (44.74, 48.32) is 8 m from the Freenodes capital and 21.57 m from the Isolationist capital, so it sits in both circles. The enclave's own hash is 25.09 m south-west, also in both circles. The 31.89 m overlap of those two capitals is the geography of a refusal to connect living inside the network that wants connection.
cultures.stops_before: A defection, a proof of who struck the third relay, and a side chosen before mid-month.

cultures.name: The cut, told from the cove
cultures.where: pirate_cove_north hash; the cut stays S13
cultures.public_fact: If it crosses their ground, it crosses their cut. The Pirates ransom messages and sell some of what they hear to cities that are hostile. They fear a week in which Couriers and Freenodes cooperate, and they fear their own captains turning each other in. Two captains are disputing one sealed message from a Concordia diplomat that the Guild was carrying. The dispute may collapse the cove. Vexa walked away from a Guild apprenticeship, built the largest band from walkaways, and meets her crew at the cove in the morning. Reputation on the sheet is 28. The currency is a ransom chit, and this slice pays none.
cultures.identity: A cove identity is a seal that still holds and a crew that has not yet split. The hash at (−16.16, 33.18) is inside the pirate disc only. The cut at (19.55, 5.29), 45.31 m away, already has two dome bandits and one road bandit. q_s13_two_cuts already ends on leaving both cuts unpaid. This culture does not send Vexa down there to collect.
cultures.stops_before: The second captain's name, the diplomat's name, the opened seal, and the twelve-year silence with Ria.

cultures.name: The perimeter with no disc
cultures.where: Unplaced militia rooms; the salt overlap; the ridge hash; the temple hash
cultures.public_fact: The Third Incursion, Year -3, broke on Zara Morn's perimeter. She has not slept eight hours since. A portal on the western perimeter opened off-schedule once, then again six months later, and now opens weekly. The militia is the faction on those sentences, and the militia has no country row, so the perimeter has a history and no capital. Dust Rose arrived at ten during the incursion and stayed, and is not stood. Mara Pin was elected to write letters and to refuse the militia's worse ideas, and her room is the volume letter quest. Silas found a western route in Year -8 and has not put it on a map. The Pioneer chair, Marsenn, has held the kitchen-born alliance for nine of its thirty years and is keeping a vote from becoming an office. The vote, on admitting an unnamed merchant family from a hostile city, has been postponed three times. The Mesh hears routing as address. Torven left a relay after a storm he calls the Routing Vision, three annums ago, and is preparing the sermon the faction tension already states.
cultures.identity: A perimeter identity is a door the post did not schedule, held by people whose rooms were never given x and z. The weekly notice in this slice is a board on Ria's hash at night. The western door itself is not a coordinate. The salt overlap is where Marsenn's hash sits, 13.14 m outside Pinewood and 9.93 m off the hitch, still inside both the Couriers disc and the Pioneer disc.
cultures.stops_before: A map of Silas's road, a body for Zara, a child on the camp edge, a sermon text, a called vote, and a theory of the portal.

side_quests.title: Post Hash — Seven Days, Unstated
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_ria_post. Clock 5–19. Temir must still be in their 6–15 window when the camp is reached.

objectives.text: At (48.72, −9.79), ask how long a peer may stay unreachable. She will say seven days, and that the Guild has not commented on the three relays sabotaged in the last lunar quarter. She will not say who struck the third.

Walk the 58.25 m to Temir at (44.74, 48.32). Hear the public tension: three relays compromised, the Guild's response was to do nothing, and Temir is debating whether to expose that silence. They do not hand over a proof.
Write seven days, three relays, Guild silent. Leave the attacker unnamed.
Bring those three facts back. She still does not comment. The errand ends on that silence.

She will say the receipt was logged at Link Post Alpha, the delivery was never logged at Sovereign, Dorvik insists he delivered it, and Kestra insists nothing arrived. She will say the Handshake failed that once, and that both factions are quietly investigating.
Write those two lines. Kestra has no sheet in this folder. Dorvik is not on a pin. Leave both of them unstood.
Walk the 3.19 m to the safehouse hash at (45.94, −8.23). It is empty. His night rest is not an encounter. Leave it empty.
Bring the two lines back. Add no third line. Do not read a manifest addressee.

Write the refusal and the missing provision. Draft no amendment.
Turn the refusal back to her as the whole errand. Lin is not summoned. The chassis is not a person you can hail on this pin.

You already have the public tension from the faction sheet: the grandson has begun delivering to the nearest Guild post, Brunn knows, and Brunn has not spoken of it. Do not ask him to speak it.

side_quests.title: Temple Hash — The Page Stays
side_quests.giver_spawn: presence_torven_temple. The writing block is 11–15, inside the 7–19 presence.

objectives.text: At (−19.74, −55.91), during the hours he writes, ask what he is preparing. The public tension is the answer he may give: senior Freenodes told him the Web is just code, and he is preparing a sermon in which that is the test the Web would set. He does not hand you the page.
Write that a sermon is being prepared. Do not copy a text. The sheet does not contain the sermon's sentences.
Walk the 6.99 m to the meditation hash at (−15.77, −50.16). It is empty. His early hour there is not interactable. Leave it empty.
Return without the page. Do not walk the 37.15 m to the pale flat to pen the herd, and do not call the pronghorn a sign.

fail: Prove the Web is or is not divine

world_hooks.board_line: A sermon is being prepared. The page stayed on the desk.

side_quests.title: Council Hash — The Third Postponement

objectives.text: At (53.82, −38.28), ask the morning minutes what is waiting. She will say two townships are voting on whether to admit a merchant family from a hostile city, and that the vote has been postponed three times. She will not name the family or the city.
Write postponed three times, family unnamed, city unnamed. Call no vote.
Walk the 9.93 m to the hitch at (54.82, −48.16). Two led horses and one guard are already there. Leave them. Do not become the giver of q_s13_salt_chord. Do not mount.
Bring the postponement back. The alliance does not gain an office from this errand. The trade-caravan hash at (41.52, −50.64), 17.44 m away, stays empty.

fail: Stand her inside the 12 m Pinewood disk

world_hooks.board_line: Postponed a third time. The family is still unnamed.
world_hooks.gossip_on_complete: Marsenn kept the minutes and kept the vote uncalled.
